implementation.snippet:
```text
kS = K_norm @ state
qS = Q_norm @ state
RHS = beta * (V - exp_gc * kS)
v_new = M_neumann @ RHS
O = scale * (exp_gc * qS + gated_qk @ v_new)
state = exp_gc_last * state + K^T @ (exp_decay * v_new)
```

```text
sum_t (K[t,k] * exp_decay[t]) * v_new[t,v]
==
sum_t K[t,k] * (exp_decay[t] * v_new[t,v])
```
